headline: Stable Labor Market Expected to Keep Federal Reserve on Track for Gradual Rate Hikes
summary: Despite deciding against raising interest rates last week, the Federal Reserve is widely expected to raise rates again in December to help tame inflation.
why: Interest rate decisions by the Federal Reserve directly influence borrowing costs, economic growth, and asset valuations across global financial markets.

impacts.name: US Federal Funds Rate
impacts.why: Expectations of further rate hikes point toward higher policy rates.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Anticipation of future interest rate increases by the Federal Reserve affects macroeconomic conditions and monetary policy expectations.
